definitions.explanation: Any device used to produce musical sounds. Covers traditional Japanese instruments, Western instruments, and electronic instruments alike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{楽器|がっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}け→弾く：02444_hiku⟧ます⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can you play any musical instrument?

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{楽器|がっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出会|であ}った→出会う：02298_deau⟧。
examples.english: I encountered the piano as an instrument when I was a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{和楽器|わがっき}→和楽器：05231_wagakki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{洋楽器|ようがっき}→洋楽器：28762_yougakki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{幅広|はばひろ}く→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}っている→取り扱う：06162_toriatsukau⟧。
examples.english: This shop carries a wide range of instruments, from traditional Japanese to Western.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{楽|がく} (music) + {器|き} (instrument, vessel).

USAGE:
{楽器|がっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧ is used for stringed and keyboard instruments, {楽器|がっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ for wind instruments, and {楽器|がっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧ for percussion. The general verb ⟦{演奏|えんそう}する→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧ (to perform) works for all types.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽器|がっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}する→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧: to play an instrument
- {楽器|がっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧: to learn an instrument
- ⟦{弦楽器|げんがっき}→弦楽器：07534_gengakki⟧: stringed instrument
- ⟦{管楽器|かんがっき}→管楽器：07533_kangakki⟧: wind instrument
- ⟦{打楽器|だがっき}→打楽器：07532_dagakki⟧: percussion instrument
- ⟦{和楽器|わがっき}→和楽器：05231_wagakki⟧: traditional Japanese instrument
